source.note: Source timestamps are not uniformly spaced. Nominal 30 fps was not used to infer frame indices. The original file was read only and its SHA-256 was checked before and after excerpt creation.

trim.reason: Retain home, stage entry, continuous battle with Fever, CLEAR result, rematch/pause and home return. Exclude initial loading and the source frames at or after 116.566667, when the Game view clears before the desktop appears.

output.visual_region: Full original recorded rectangle; no spatial crop, overlays or synthetic frames added to the proof video.
output.pts_preservation: All 3025 output frames compared: output PTS equals the corresponding selected source PTS minus 89088.

visual_inspection.method: Actual ffmpeg extraction followed by Codex view_image inspection. Source overview, boundary and Fever sequences plus four exact final-output samples were viewed. This is sample review and endpoint inspection, not a claim that every frame was visually reviewed.

source_overview.selection: fps=1/5, 4x6 grid in chronological order; full recorded rectangle scaled for inspection. Resampled grid times are approximate selection times.

source_start_overview.selection: Original PTS [0,5), fps=4. Initial editor/loading views.

source_start_game.selection: Original PTS [5,8), fps=5. Home, stage selection, then battle.

source_fever_sequence.selection: Original PTS [65,74), fps=1. QTE/Perfect and Fever battle sequence; labels are resampled grid PTS.

source_end_overview.selection: Original PTS [112,118), fps=5. Phase transition, CLEAR result, rematch, pause, home, Game view clearing, then desktop.

exact_end_boundary.observation: Home remains visible through 116.533333; Game view is cleared at 116.566667.
exact_end_boundary.selection: Every available source frame in PTS seconds [116.3,116.7), exact PTS labels, no fps resampling.

samples.name: first
samples.observation: Exact first output frame: game home visible in Unity Game view.

samples.name: fever
samples.observation: Fever battle HUD with purple Fever time bar, active battle effects and the in-game Activate Fever Time tutorial panel; Unity remains visible.

samples.name: result
samples.observation: CLEAR!! result panel with HOME and NEXT buttons in Unity Game view.

samples.name: last
samples.observation: Exact last output frame: game home remains visible. The editor stop control has changed, but the Game view has not yet cleared; no desktop is present.

visual_inspection.recorded_foreground_warning: run.json reports foreground warnings. The accepted excerpt is supported by inspected visible game content, exact endpoint checks and full decoding.
visual_inspection.conclusion: PASS: continuous recorded Unity gameplay excerpt includes Fever HUD and battle effects, CLEAR result and home return. Inspected samples and exact output endpoints contain game content with no desktop.

decoding.scope: All 3025 final-output frames decoded with -xerror; no decoding errors reported.

runtime_milestones.evidence: Fever via QTE Submit (not injected); fever=True; DriveResolve accepted=True timing=Perfect

corroboration.note: Runtime milestone times are not video timestamps. Logs corroborate accepted Fever interactions; video samples establish visible game content. OS touch input is not claimed.
